Riley Davis
Junior Product Designer

Skills:
Adobe XD, UX Design, Visual Design, Figma, Design Systems, Prototyping, UI Design, After Effects, Sketch, Wireframing

Experience:
Junior Product Designer with extensive experience building scalable systems and leading cross-functional teams. Proven track record of delivering high-quality products on time and mentoring junior developers.

Key Achievements:

• Improved system performance by 40%
• Mentored team members and improved code quality
• Implemented best practices and coding standards
